MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The memory cards fit my Raspberry Pi projects and earlier microSD purchases, so they feel like useful supplies for something I already do.",
    "The card-and-reader bundle is especially appealing because it combines storage with a convenient way to transfer project files."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo devices and Fire TV players serve voice-assistant and streaming needs that I haven't expressed through my computer accessories and tinkering purchases.",
    "A 4TB internal SSD assumes a storage upgrade I haven't planned, while sport earbuds don't follow naturally from my desk-oriented headphone accessories.",
    "The other microSD cards are relevant alternatives, but choosing the bundle would satisfy my immediate need; I wouldn't buy all of them together."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying electronics seems to have been treated as interest in smart speakers and streaming devices, even though their purpose differs from my recent purchases.",
    "My interest in memory cards seems to have been stretched into a need for a large internal drive, although those purchases solve different problems."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My Raspberry Pi, case, keyboard, cables, and adapters suggest that compatibility and usefulness within a particular setup matter to me.",
    "My more recent Ethernet adapter, patch cables, headphone mount, and duster point toward maintaining and organizing a computer workspace.",
    "Frequent accessory purchases don't mean I currently need every related device; a recommendation needs a clear role in a project or setup."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The memory cards fit my hands-on computing interests, but much of the list mistakes that interest for a general desire for home electronics."
}
